note: Both sets cover the same core facts (5 rpm minimum speed, 7.55 rpm rated speed at 10.59 m/s, 95 m/s tip speed, 0° pitch at design TSR, the three wind-speed regions) and both repeat claims heavily and share the same misbinding of "partial-load-pole (pitch controller)". Set A adds a clearly wrong claim binding 0.03 Hz as the damping of the partial-load/torque-controller poles (it is the full-load/pitch-controller natural frequency), states the minimum rotor speed as a wind-speed range, and invents "steady-state" conditions for tip speed and pitch. Set B's faults are mostly quote fidelity (the "(P3)" quote, the garbled DTU pole quote) plus one vague "value" attribute, but its bindings are generally sound and it uniquely captures the positive pitch at low wind speeds for maximum-power tracking. Set B is therefore slightly more faithful overall, while A uniquely adds the start-pitching fact at 10.59 m/s.
